items.item: The main endpoint the exercise asks for answers a valid request
items.criteria: The route exists under the documented prefix and returns the response schema for a valid body

items.item: Empty or refused model replies are detected and reported with the real cause
items.criteria: A test sends an empty or refused reply and checks that a clear error with the real cause is raised

items.item: Secrets come from configuration, never from code
items.criteria: No keys in source; the real config file is listed in .gitignore

items.item: Business logic is separate from the interface layer
items.criteria: Route handlers do not call the model SDK directly

items.item: Main behavior: a valid request produces the result the exercise asks for
items.criteria: A real request returns a model result in the format the exercise asks for
